nodes.natural_language: Let $n $ be an integer greater than or equal to 2.  Prove that if $k^2 + k + n $ is prime for all integers $k $ such that $ 0 \leq k \leq \sqrt{n/3} $, then $k^2 + k + n $ is prime for all integers $k $ such that $0 \leq k \leq n - 2 $.
